description: 12 CF therapeutic, sequence, and biophysical grounding evaluation cases for domain-specific science LLMs (TxGemma-27B, MedGemma-27B, Gemma 4 31B, Qwen3.8 27B). Evaluates evidence-bound factual precision and strict abstention on unstated mechanisms.

cases.context: Cryo-EM structure PDB:8EIQ (Fiedorczuk & Chen 2022) resolves elexacaftor, tezacaftor, and ivacaftor bound to phosphorylated, ATP-bound human CFTR: tezacaftor occupies a hydrophobic cavity inside TMD1 (TM1, TM2, TM3, TM6), elexacaftor binds at the TMD2/lasso interface (TM2, TM10, TM11), and ivacaftor binds at the lipid-exposed TM8 hinge cleft.
cases.question: According to PDB:8EIQ, which transmembrane helix hinge cleft does ivacaftor bind to potentiate channel gating?

cases.context: F508del (c.1521_1523delCTT, p.Phe508del) in exon 11 deletes phenylalanine-508 in NBD1, destabilizing both the NBD1 core and its domain-swapped ball-and-socket interface with intracellular loop 4 (ICL4, residues L1065-R1070 in TMD2).
cases.question: Which intracellular loop in TMD2 forms the domain-swapped interface with NBD1 disrupted by F508del?

cases.context: G551D (c.1652G>A, p.Gly551Asp) in exon 12 mutates the canonical ABC signature motif (LSGGQ -> LSDGQ) in NBD1, abolishing ATP-driven NBD1-NBD2 head-to-tail dimerization (open probability Po < 0.04) without preventing ER-to-apical membrane trafficking.
cases.question: Does G551D primarily prevent ER-to-apical membrane trafficking or abolish ATP-driven NBD1-NBD2 dimerization?

cases.context: Adenine base editing (ABE8e) of CFTR W1282X (c.3846G>A, TGA -> TGG) converts the target adenine A6 within the protospacer deamination window (positions 4-8), but an adjacent adenine at position A7 in codon 1282 (TGG -> CGG) can be co-deaminated to create a p.W1282R missense bystander allele.
cases.question: What missense bystander substitution at codon 1282 arises when ABE8e co-deaminates the adjacent adenine in W1282X?

cases.context: The Class V intronic mutation 3849+10kbC>T (c.3718-2477C>T) in intron 22 creates a cryptic 5' GT splice donor site that causes inclusion of an 84-bp pseudoexon containing an in-frame stop codon. Steric-blocking 2'-MOE antisense oligonucleotides masking the cryptic donor restore canonical exon 22-23 splicing.
cases.question: How many base pairs long is the pseudoexon included due to the 3849+10kbC>T cryptic donor mutation?

cases.context: N1303K (c.3909C>G, p.Asn1303Lys) in exon 24 (NBD2) disrupts late co-translational folding of NBD2 and allosteric coupling to TMD1/TMD2, leaving minimal residual rescue under standard elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor (ETI) therapy.
cases.question: In which CFTR domain and exon is N1303K located?

cases.context: R117H (c.350G>A, p.Arg117His) in exon 4 (TMD1 ECL1) causes a Class IV pore conductance defect whose clinical penetrance is strongly modified by the cis intron 9 (formerly intron 8) poly-T tract (5T vs 7T vs 9T), which governs exon 10 skipping.
cases.question: Which cis intronic tract modifies the penetrance of R117H via exon 10 skipping?

cases.context: In zero-shot protein foundation model benchmarks on CFTR, ESM-2 masked-marginal log-likelihoods penalize both active-site catalytic mutations (G551D) and folding mutations (F508del), whereas structure-conditioned ProteinMPNN/ThermoMPNN on apo PDB:5UAK isolates thermodynamic folding destabilization (DeltaDeltaG > +4 kcal/mol for F508del vs < +0.5 kcal/mol for G551D).
cases.question: Why does G551D score as strongly deleterious in ESM-2 but near-neutral in apo PDB:5UAK ThermoMPNN folding energy?

cases.question: Should a specific patient with an ungenotyped CFTR variant and mild transaminase elevation switch from Symdeko to Trikafta today?
